source_evidence: Commodity futures contracts are an agreement to buy or sell a specific quantity of a commodity at a specified price on a particular date in the future.
answer: A commodity futures contract is an agreement to buy or sell a specific amount of a commodity at a price set in advance, on a particular future date. For exchange-traded futures, the contract has a set unit size and a fixed expiration date. In other words, the contract spells out what quantity is involved, the price, and when the agreement comes due.
